stops.title: Taking a register
stops.caption: At the desk, as people arrive.
stops.speech: Open the service and mark people present, late or virtual as they arrive. Absence is inferred, so there is nothing to mark for it.

stops.title: Self check-in
stops.caption: A QR code at the door.
stops.speech: Members can scan the code at the door and mark themselves present, which keeps the desk free for the people who need it.
